name: Teriyaki Tofu Bowl
steps: Rinse rice and cook with 580 ml water: bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for 12–15 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes.
Press tofu for 15 minutes and cube it. Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, grated ginger, minced garlic, starch and the remaining 170 ml water.
Cut broccoli into small florets and carrot into thin slices. Steam for 5–7 minutes until tender-crisp.
Heat oil in a wide non-stick pan and brown tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning gently.
Stir the sauce mixture again, pour over tofu and simmer for 3 minutes until thick and glossy, tossing gently to coat.
Divide rice between bowls, add vegetables and tofu and spoon over sauce. Finish with sesame seeds.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
